the-royal-opera-tosca.title: Royal Ballet & Opera 2025/26: Tosca
the-royal-opera-tosca.overview: In war-torn Rome, Floria Tosca and Mario Cavaradossi live for each other and for their art. But when Cavaradossi helps an escaped prisoner, the lovers make a deadly enemy in the form of Baron Scarpia, Chief of Police. At the mercy of Scarpia’s twisted desires, Tosca is forced to make a horrific bargain: sleeping with the man she hates in order to save the man she loves. Can she find a way out?
the-royal-opera-tosca.cast: Anna Netrebko, Freddie De Tommaso, Gerald Finley, Carlo Bosi, Ossian Huskinson, Alessandro Corbelli

the-royal-ballet-swan-lake.title: The Royal Ballet: Swan Lake
the-royal-ballet-swan-lake.overview: Prince Siegfried chances upon a flock of swans while out hunting. When one of the swans turns into a beautiful woman, Odette, he is enraptured. But she is under a spell that holds her captive, allowing her to regain her human form only at night.

the-royal-ballet-romeo-juliet.title: The Royal Ballet: Romeo and Juliet
the-royal-ballet-romeo-juliet.overview: An ancient family feud casts a long shadow over the town of Verona. In this hothouse of tension, brawls are quick to break out and both sides get caught in the crossfire.
the-royal-ballet-romeo-juliet.cast: Vadim Muntagirov, Fumi Kaneko, Francisco Serrano, Ryoichi Hirano, Giacomo Rovero, Lukas Bjørneboe Brændsrød

spa-weekend.title: Spa Weekend
spa-weekend.overview: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.
spa-weekend.cast: Leslie Mann, Michelle Buteau, Anna Faris, Isla Fisher, Adam Demos, Dominic Ona-Ariki

giant-the-play.title: Giant
giant-the-play.overview: Set in the summer of 1983, just before the release of The Witches, Giant imagines a tense meeting between Roald Dahl and his American and British publishers as they scramble to contain the fallout from his public denunciation of Israel and defence of the Palestinians in a review of a book on the 1982 Lebanon war. Filmed live onstage at the Harold Pinter Theatre in London's West End in 2025.
giant-the-play.cast: John Lithgow, Elliot Levey, Aya Cash, Rachael Stirling, Tessa Bonham Jones, Richard Hope

one-night-only.title: One Night Only
one-night-only.overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.
one-night-only.cast: Monica Barbaro, Callum Turner, Maya Hawke, King Princess, Molly Ringwald, LeVar Burton

english-national-ballet-presents-the-sle.title: English National Ballet presents The Sleeping Beauty
english-national-ballet-presents-the-sle.overview: A spellbinding fairytale ballet filmed at London’s Royal Albert Hall.  Sir Kenneth MacMillan’s exquisite ballet will leave you spellbound. A stunning version of one of the world’s favourite fairytales, filmed at London’s Royal Albert Hall.  Featuring First Soloist Anna Nevzorova as Aurora and Davi Ramos as Prince Désiré, the film will whisk you away to an enchanted land and a story of good versus evil. As a baby, Princess Aurora is cursed by the wicked Carabosse (Eireen Evrard). Her godmother, the Lilac Fairy (Anri Sugiura), alters the spell so Aurora will not die, but sleep for 100 years. Only a true love’s kiss can awaken her.  From Aurora’s christening in the palace, to her jubilant wedding, the bewitching tale is brought to life before your eyes through beautiful choreography, sumptuous costumes and stunning new projection sets by Charlotte MacMillan.
english-national-ballet-presents-the-sle.cast: Anna Nevzorova, Eireen Evrard, Anri Sugiura, Davi Ramos

coyote-vs-acme.title: Coyote vs. Acme
coyote-vs-acme.overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.
coyote-vs-acme.cast: Will Forte, Lana Condor, John Cena, Tone Bell, Martha Kelly, Luis Guzmán

mare-s-nest.title: Mare's Nest
mare-s-nest.overview: Moon travels through a mysterious unexplained world free of adults. Moon meets a scholar turned sage and her translator in a mountain hut, where she tries to understand what is happening, based on a play by Don DeLillo. She meets many others who perform for her, show her a film, give her gifts, show her different possibilities for living. She observes and moves on into an unknown future.
mare-s-nest.cast: Moon Guo Barker, Astrid Ihora, Elahni-ja'nai Nembhard, Iris Andueza Reig, Saioia Andueza Reig, Sofia Hurtado Lichel

dance-fitness.title: Dance Fitness for Beginners - Urban Street Heat
dance-fitness.overview: Who knew getting a full-body cardio workout could be so much fun!  Urban Street Heat is more like a dance party than an aerobics class.  MaDonna Grimes makes working out fun in this fresh and funky Dance Fitness for Beginners program.

amazing-animals.title: Amazing Animals
amazing-animals.overview: Jason Kenzie, a local pet photojournalist discovers a myriad of exotic animals living in the backyards of the lower mainland of British Columbia Canada.

the-makings-of-a-murderer-the-undercover.title: Selfless: The Makings of a Champion
the-makings-of-a-murderer-the-undercover.overview: Get to know a little more about the Hunter Lawrence story with this short film titled Selfless: The Makings of a Champion. With insights from father Darren Lawrence, brother Jett, and of course Hunter Lawrence himself, it’s a unique look into the mindset and moral compass of an athlete who has both enjoyed and endured one of the most impressive journeys to the top of our sport.
the-makings-of-a-murderer-the-undercover.cast: Hunter Lawrence, Jett Lawrence, Darren Lawrence

jim-davidson-no-holes-barred.title: Jim Davidson: No Further Action - Back & Live
jim-davidson-no-holes-barred.overview: Comedy legend Jim Davidson returns with his brand new DVD Back & Live! filmed during his No Further Action UK tour. Jim takes a wry look at what life is like under investigation in the public eye as he tells the story of his year from hell following his arrest by Operation Yewtree detectives. He gives an honest and witty account of fighting to clear his name, subsequently having all allegations against him dropped and winning the heart of the nation all over again when he was crowned the winner of the most successful series of Big Brother by a landslide public vote. Hear the outrageous unseen stories of the Celebrity Big Brother house and what Jim really thought about his fellow housemates!

bridesmaids-at-the-ritz.overview: Annie's life is a mess. But when she finds out her lifetime best friend is engaged, she simply must serve as Lillian's maid of honor. Though lovelorn and broke, Annie bluffs her way through the expensive and bizarre rituals. With one chance to get it perfect, she’ll show Lillian and her bridesmaids just how far you’ll go for someone you love.

fred-dinenage-s-ronnie-reggie-me.title: Fred
fred-dinenage-s-ronnie-reggie-me.overview: Fred (Vincent Lindon) is a former crane driver who was a victim of the closure of his factory. He takes care of the little boy of his girlfriend (Clotilde Courau), does the housework and sometimes goes to the job center but boredom is inescapable. One day, because he accepted to drive a truck for a friend to a warehouse, he's caught up in a vicious spiral that goes beyond him. It's all the more serious as shady men want to eliminate him an the police is on his back.
fred-dinenage-s-ronnie-reggie-me.cast: Vincent Lindon, Clotilde Courau, François Berléand, Stéphane Jobert, Roschdy Zem, Albert Dray

blazing-saddles-1974-at-the-ritz.title: Blazing Saddles
blazing-saddles-1974-at-the-ritz.overview: Crafty railroad worker Bart becomes the first Black sheriff of Rock Ridge, a frontier town about to be destroyed in order to make way for a new railroad. Initially, the citizens of Rock Ridge harbor a racial bias toward their new protector. However, they warm to him after realizing that Bart and his perpetually drunk gunfighter friend Jim are their only defense against a wave of thugs sent to rid the town of its population.
blazing-saddles-1974-at-the-ritz.cast: Cleavon Little, Gene Wilder, Slim Pickens, Harvey Korman, Madeline Kahn, Mel Brooks

back-to-the-80s-with-riviera-dogs-2027.title: Back to the 80s
back-to-the-80s-with-riviera-dogs-2027.overview: Comedy hip-hop duo Ben & Jensen (actor/director Ben Giroux and songwriter/artist Jensen Reed) present "Back to the 80s" -- an epic parody celebration of the entire 80s decade! Featuring their alter ego faux hair band: WET LEATHER.  This project is the massive sequel to the 2017 "Back to the 90s" music video, which amassed 95 million views on Facebook and charted at #11 on Billboard. "Back to the 80s" took over two years to create, featuring 50 custom sets and multiple iconic vehicles from the 80s -- filmed over the course of six months. Hold on to your mullets...

There's also a couple of dick jokes. In a nutshell then, something for everyone.
